source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?height ?countryLabel ?opened WHERE { { SELECT ?item (MAX(?h) AS ?height) (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(COALESCE(STR(?opT), ""), "|", COALESCE(STR(?opP), "")); separator=";") AS ?op) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(COALESCE(STR(?stT), ""), "|", COALESCE(STR(?stP), "")); separator=";") AS ?st) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q11303 ; p:P2048/psn:P2048/wikibase:quantityAmount ?h . FILTER(?h >= 300) OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P17 ?c } OPTIONAL { ?item p:P1619 ?opSt . ?opSt a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P1619 [ wikibase:timeValue ?opT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?opP ] . } OPTIONAL { ?item p:P580 ?stSt . ?stSt a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P580 [ wikibase:timeValue ?stT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?stP ] . } } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . BIND(IF(CONTAINS(?op, "-"), ?op, ?st) AS ?opened) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160
